input.current_sentence: The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
input.context_before: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
input.context_after: Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.
input.selected_text: The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.

output.main_clause: The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
structure_breakdown: 前一分句：主语 The team + 谓语 has + 宾语 pockets of greatness + 范围状语 in design。
后一分句：主语 it（指代 the team）+ 谓语 struggles + 不定式补足成分 to deliver consistently。
并列连词 but 连接两个独立分句，形成语义转折。
logic_relations: but 连接前后分句，形成「局部有优势 vs 整体不稳定」的转折对比。
承接上一句「客观评估团队表现」，给出具体评估结论。
information_hierarchy: 先给出团队设计领域的局部优势，再转折指出整体交付不稳定的问题。
后一分句为语义重心，突出团队当前的核心短板。
style_features: 两个分句长度相近，结构对称，形成平衡的转折对比。
用词平实客观，符合工作复盘的正式沟通风格。
grammar_points: pockets of + 抽象名词表示零散分布的少量特质，greatness 为不可数名词。
struggle to do sth 表示费力做某事，to deliver 是 struggles 的不定式补足成分。
wording_notes: pockets of greatness 是比喻用法，指零散存在的优秀表现，而非完整的强大实力。
consistently 修饰 deliver，强调交付质量的稳定性不足。

translations.label: 直译
translations.text: 这个团队在设计领域有零星的优秀表现，但它仍然难以稳定地交付成果。

translations.label: 意译
translations.text: 这个团队在设计上有不少亮眼的地方，但整体交付始终不够稳定。

translation_notes: pockets of greatness 译为「零星的优秀表现」或「不少亮眼的地方」，贴合职场复盘语境。
evidence: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.
